analysis.summary: Arguzz tests zero-knowledge virtual machines for soundness and completeness bugs -- cases where a zk VM accepts a proof of a false statement, or rejects a proof of a true one. Both are security-critical, since a zk VM's whole purpose is that its verdicts can be trusted without re-execution.
